    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer sfa_"q\uo'te"
snippet.claude: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user sidefleet https://fleet.example.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer sfa_"q\uo'te"

message.hermes:
Please connect yourself to my Sidefleet, so you can run coding tasks on my machines for me.

Add this MCP server to your config in ~/.hermes/config.yaml (under mcp_servers), then reload your MCP servers:

mcp_servers:
  sidefleet:
    url: "https://fleet.example.com/mcp"
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer sfa_"q\uo'te"

When it's connected, use Sidefleet's fleet_overview tool and tell me which machines you can see.
message.openclaw:
Please connect yourself to my Sidefleet, so you can run coding tasks on my machines for me.

Run this command to add the Sidefleet MCP server:

openclaw mcp set sidefleet '{"url":"https://fleet.example.com/mcp","transport":"streamable-http","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer sfa_\"q\\uo'te"}}'

When it's connected, use Sidefleet's fleet_overview tool and tell me which machines you can see.
message.claude:
Please connect yourself to my Sidefleet, so you can run coding tasks on my machines for me.

Run this command to add the Sidefleet MCP server for all my projects:

claude mcp add --transport http --scope user sidefleet https://fleet.example.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer sfa_"q\uo'te"

When it's connected, use Sidefleet's fleet_overview tool and tell me which machines you can see.
message.other:
URL: https://fleet.example.com/mcp
Header: Authorization: Bearer sfa_"q\uo'te

updatesMessage.hermes:
Please set yourself up so Sidefleet can tell you about my coding tasks, and you can tell me here.

1. Make sure your webhook server is on: WEBHOOK_ENABLED=true in ~/.hermes/.env (port 8644). If you have to change it, restart your gateway.

2. Run this command. If you know this chat's id, add --deliver-chat-id with it so updates come to this chat:

hermes webhook subscribe sidefleet --prompt "{text}" --deliver slack --mirror-to-session --secret sec --description "Sidefleet task updates"

When a Sidefleet update arrives, tell me about it in a short message and help me act on it with the Sidefleet tools.
updatesMessage.openclaw:
Please set yourself up so Sidefleet can tell you about my coding tasks, and you can tell me here.

Turn on your webhooks: in your config (~/.openclaw/openclaw.json) set

hooks: {
  enabled: true,
  token: "sec",
  path: "/hooks",
},

then restart your gateway (openclaw gateway restart).

When a Sidefleet update arrives, tell me about it in a short message and help me act on it with the Sidefleet tools.
